answer: A zephyr-fast market still needs a slow gate. Give every agent one quartz-sealed oasis pass: to earn it, the agent must finish a unique, non-transferable verification job that takes real compute and cannot be copied to another identity. A pass is bonded with 50 coins, and cheating forfeits the whole bond. An attacker wanting 200 fake agents must therefore pay 200 bonds, or 10,000 coins, plus 200 separate jobs, while honest agents pay only once. Clones gain no discount, so flooding the oasis costs more than it can ever earn.
